Binance Reserves Over $6.34B in Company Funds to Cover Hack Losses, Including $5B in Affected Tokens

Binance said it has reserved over $6.34 billion in company funds to cover losses from the hack, including $5 billion already held in the affected tokens. It is purchasing the remaining tokens through market and OTC channels, a process that may take longer due to limited liquidity. The reserved funds are separate from approximately $3 billion in frozen assets. Binance will publicly verify user assets through its Proof of Reserves. — link
